messages:
Emily_CS: Incoming ticket — customer can't start free trial, signup blocked with 'account flagged for abuse'. They supplied email john+trial2026@mail-temp.org and IP 45.77.122.19. Screenshot attached. Please check and advise.
Matt_Support: Looking. I pulled the signup event: created 2026-03-14 16:15 UTC. No payment token present (free trial). Error in UI: 'trial blocked — risk_check'.
FraudBot: Automated risk summary for john+trial2026@mail-temp.org — risk_score=78 (HIGH). Signals: disposable-email-domain(mail-temp.org), VPN/Proxy detected (ASN 20456), IP reused by 4 other recent signups in last 12h, rapid-account-creation pattern.
Raj_Ops: :eyes: Disposable email + VPN + IP reuse is noisy. Do we have any customer-provided proof (phone, company domain)?
Emily_CS: Customer replied with a phone number (sent SMS, no reply yet) and says they're an indie dev building a plugin. No company domain. They said they used a personal gmail for other tasks but signed up with that mail+alias.
Tina_Policy: We require manual Trust & Safety review for disposables + active VPN signals before granting a trial. If phone verification can't be completed, escalation needed.
Emily_CS: Can we do a temporary override to unblock while we collect verification? They say they need trial to test behavior quickly.
Sam_Eng: If _policy_ approves, support can perform a one-off via admin console. CLI snippet: 
```
# grant 14-day trial via CLI
rwdctl users grant-trial --email "john+trial2026@mail-temp.org" --days 14 --note "Support override pending T&S review; case TS-2026-055"
```
Matt_Support: I don't want to override without T&S signoff. Risk score suggests we should be cautious.
Raj_Ops: Escalating to Trust & Safety now. Case ID TS-2026-055 created and posted in #trust-safety. Pinged @Tina_Policy for review.
Tina_Policy: Reviewed logs and signal set. Given user provided phone and has low activity beyond wanting to test, approving a one-time 7-day trial with monitoring. Conditions: (1) Add support note, (2) enable 7-day trial, (3) set watch flag for 72h for token abuse.
Matt_Support: Got it — performing override now. Will add note and set watch.
Matt_Support: Completed — granted 7-day trial to john+trial2026@mail-temp.org. Admin action id: admin-987621. Note: "Override approved TS-2026-055 by Tina_Policy; monitor 72h."
Emily_CS: Customer confirmed they can access trial now. Leaving a follow-up for phone verification later.
Raj_Ops: Marking case monitored. I'll pull token usage logs every 6h for 72h.
Emily_CS: Closing ticket after follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
